intent: New companion tab concepts using supplied image as style reference

prompts.name: 01-schedule
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: matching companion tab screenshot for an existing Android habit tracker.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the user's approved Soft Sage Today design. Create a NEW screen for the specified other tab, retaining precisely this visual family: pale sage #E4EBDF canvas, white rounded 24px habit/cards, forest green #20594C prominent cards and CTAs, dark charcoal-green text, restrained amber accent, generous space, soft shadows, friendly bold rounded sans serif heading, green line icons on pale sage tiles. The supplied reference is not an edit target. Match its overall visual scale, heading weight, card radii, side margins, floating white bottom navigation and typography. No new design direction.
ONE complete 1024x1536 portrait screen, front-on flat screenshot; no device frame, no perspective, no collage, no external annotations, no watermark. Crisp accurately spelled English interface text, comfortably readable at normal mobile size. Native Android status bar at top, 9:41, battery 100%, gesture safe area at bottom. Fixed white floating rounded bottom navigation EXACTLY matching the reference with FOUR evenly spaced items and icons: "Today", "Schedule", "Progress", "Profile". Select only the tab specified below in forest green, others gray. Do not add a fifth tab. Keep every element and all navigation labels visible without overlap. Mobile-first touch targets, clear content hierarchy, no tiny dense text.
This existing app has habits, routines, recurring schedules, count and duration goals, weekly/monthly progress, local profile, achievements and personal challenges. Do not invent social feeds, login, cloud sync, AI assistants, checkout, notification bells or payment offers. Sample data is for design preview.
Screen: SCHEDULE, Schedule navigation selected.
Large header "Schedule", below "A little structure. Room to breathe.", a small outline filter control on header right. Date strip exactly like reference: Mon 26, Tue 27, Wed 28, Thu 29, Fri 30, Sat 31, Sun 1; Sat 31 deep-green selected. Compact Day / Week segmented control with "Day" selected. Date title "Saturday, October 31".
Main content is a beautiful clean chronological vertical timeline with understated green line and small dots at left, and five compact white rounded event cards at right, each using consistent left time labels and simple relevant icons:
"7:00 AM" / "Morning walk" / "20 min" / a green check showing completed.
"8:00 AM" / "Stretch" / "10 min" / a green check showing completed.
"9:00 AM" / "Drink water" / "2 of 8 glasses" / a pale sage "+1" action.
"10:00 AM" / "Read a book" / "20 min" / a forest green "Start" button with play icon; subtle small "Up next" marker.
"8:00 PM" / "Plan tomorrow" / "5 min" / unchecked completion control.
Two completed and three pending entries total, consistent with approved Today sample. Add tiny overflow menus for rescheduling, no popover open. These cards should fit with comfortable reading space; compact timeline is the focal point. Under timeline a slim "Browse routines" row with layers icon and chevron if room. Primary full-width pill "+ Add habit" directly above fixed navigation. No progress summary needed on this tab. The result must look like the Schedule tab of precisely the same app as the style reference.
